coverage_delta: +13 integration tests in AutoDispatchJobTests; full suite 736 pass, 0 fail, 4 skip (perf), no regressions
notes: RED was observed: CS0246 'AutoDispatchJob type not found' build error confirmed before writing any implementation.

Design-review F-1 (MEDIUM) implemented: pending-offer exclusion (drivers who are DriverId of any Assigned order in the fleet) is queried INSIDE each per-order fresh scope — not in the scan phase — so prior same-tick commits are visible. This is the SOLE within-tick guard; RunTick_TwoNewOrdersOneEligibleDriver_AssignsExactlyOne verifies it.

Design-review F-2 (LOW) implemented: CreatedAt and ScheduledAt are included in the scan projection tuple. In-memory filtering mirrors OfferTimeoutJob pattern to avoid EF DateTimeOffset arithmetic translation issues.

OrderEvent entity has required FleetId/FromStatus/ToStatus/ActorRole columns. Directly seeded OrderEvents in tests must populate all non-nullable FK and enum columns; missing fields caused FK violation on fk_order_events_fleets_fleet_id. Fixed in test seeds for TimedOutDriverExcluded and ManualAssignWinsRace. Added to CLAUDE.md project-specific facts.
PickupLat/PickupLng are non-nullable double columns on the Order entity — the '?? 0.0' null-coalescing operator was invalid (CS0019). Removed after checking Order.cs.

Per-fleet settings query uses three separate (bool?)/(int?)/(int?) correlated subqueries with IgnoreQueryFilters() on FleetSettings — mirrors OfferTimeoutJob's proven (int?) guard pattern. All three must be nullable so a missing FleetSettings row returns null not false/0.
AutoDispatchJob gating is asymmetric vs OfferTimeoutJob: missing settings row SKIPS (no safe default for auto-dispatch), while OfferTimeoutJob falls back to DefaultTimeoutSeconds=45.

BackgroundJobTests.cs SeedFleetAndDriver seeds a driver with Status=Free but LastLat/LastLng/LastPositionAt=null by default. Each happy-path test must set these fields near the pickup and set LastPositionAt=FixedNow.AddMinutes(-1) for SelectNearest to pass the freshness check.

TwoEligibleDrivers test: driverFar was seeded via a second SeedFleetAndDriver call which creates a new fleet. The test reassigns driverFar.FleetId to fleetA so both drivers are in the same fleet for the query filter to work. The extra fleet from the second seed has no auto-dispatch settings and causes no side effects.
The RunTickAsync is public (not internal) matching OfferTimeoutJob — required for test access without InternalsVisibleTo or reflection.
StaleThreshold constant = TimeSpan.FromMinutes(5) matches StalePositionJob.StaleThreshold, per spec Assumption 4.
Actor.System is used for the Assign transition (null ActorUserId → no FK violation on order_events.actor_user_id), confirmed by design-review V-2.

RunTick_ManualAssignWinsRace_JobNoOp tests pre-assignment scan-filtering (order already Assigned before tick → skipped at scan). The concurrent-tick else-branch path (StaleVersion/IllegalTransition from TransitionAsync) is covered by the 13th test: RunTick_TwoConcurrentTicks_ExactlyOneAssignedEvent uses Task.WhenAll to run two ticks concurrently; one wins the Version token, the other hits the LogDebug else-branch. Exactly one Assigned event is written.
